paragraphs.text: "TOGETHER, WE CREATE MORE THAN A WALL PAINTING. EACH COMMISSION IS A CREATIVE COLLABORATION, RESULTING IN AN ARTWORK THAT BECOMES AN INTEGRAL PART OF THE SPACE."

Every project begins with a conversation about your space, the atmosphere you wish to create, and the story it might tell. After receiving photographs and dimensions, Marie meets with you - either in person or online - to explore ideas, inspiration and possibilities.

From these conversations, she develops a bespoke mood board of imagery, colour palettes and references, accompanied by an initial project estimate. Once the artistic direction is established, a concept sketch or colour study allows you to see how the artwork will live within the architecture before painting begins.
The design is then refined together until every element feels balanced and entirely at home. A timeline is agreed, and the transformation begins.

Working exclusively with carefully selected water-based paints - including emulsion, acrylic, mineral and chalk finishes - Marie creates each artwork either directly onto the wall or on bespoke panels in her studio, depending on the project. Fast drying and low in odour, these finishes allow the space to remain comfortable throughout the process.
Every commission is entirely bespoke, created specifically for the people who live in or move through the space, and for the place it was always meant to inhabit.
READY TO TRANSFORM YOUR SPACE ? Marie would love to hear your ideas and begin creating something truly extraordinary together.

process.heading: Process
process.intro: Each project is developed individually and typically includes:

steps.text:
Discovery -
A conversation to explore the space, the client's vision, and the atmosphere they wish to create.

Concept Design - 
Marie develops a bespoke artistic concept together with a detailed project proposal with a cost estimate.

Refinement - 
The design evolves through a creative dialogue until every element feels perfectly at home within the space.

Creation - 
The artwork is brought to life either on-site as a hand-painted mural or in the studio as painted panels or canvas, depending on the project.

investment.heading: Investment
investment.intro: Are you ready to transform your space ?

points.text: Final investment depends on the scale of the project, complexity of the design, and/or overall project conditions.
Lead times typically range from 3–6 months, so early booking is recommended
